narrative.headline: The Golden Knights lead the power rankings
narrative.blurb: 48 games on this week's slate. The Golden Knights are No. 1 at 8-2-0 with a +18 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Maple Leafs on 10 points. The West's last spot is the Stars on 9 points. The Golden Knights lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +11 goals over the last three games.
